sections.title: Decentralized model and Dynamic Shadowing
sections.description: Protocol mechanics described by the manual report, kept separate from SQL schema recommendations.

blocks.title: Public-contract prop trading
paragraphs: The report characterizes HyperPNL as a decentralized on-chain prop platform: challenge fees flow to a public Payout Treasury, payout state is finalized by code, and fee, performance and payout transactions are intended to be publicly auditable on-chain.

Dynamic Shadowing is described as a hybrid risk model. Simulated trades are grounded in live Hyperliquid prices and depth, while a capital-backed Shadow Engine mirrors and aggregates profitable funded-trader exposure on the exchange.

items.label: Settlement model
items.note: Report detail; human approval/rejection is described as absent after cryptographic validation.

items.label: Dynamic Shadowing
items.value: Profitable funded positions are dynamically mirrored with treasury-backed capital
items.note: Proprietary risk-engine description from the report; not independently verified here.

items.label: Market grounding
items.value: Live prices and depth from Hyperliquid DEX

items.label: Public verifiability
items.value: Fees, signatures, checkpoints and payouts intended to be auditable on-chain

items.label: Dynamic daily drawdown
items.value: At 00:00 UTC, equity becomes the 24-hour reference; breach level is reference equity × 95% and does not trail intraday

items.label: Profitable day
items.value: Realized plus unrealized PnL reaches ≥0.5% of initial balance at any point in the UTC day

items.label: Unrealized reset
items.value: Unrealized profit does not carry profitable-day credit across 00:00 UTC

items.label: Three scenarios
items.value: Unclosed floating profit: no locked credit; threshold hit with open position: day may qualify and target completion closes it; overnight trade: realized profit credits the closing day

items.label: 1 · State finalization
items.value: Backend consolidates trade history, verifies at least 1% profit and checks drawdown compliance

items.label: 2 · User commitment
items.value: Trader reviews the performance summary and signs the state with a Web3 wallet

items.label: 3 · On-chain settlement
items.value: Data Recorder validates the signed state and authorizes Payout Treasury release to the trader wallet

blocks.text: The report's pipeline example states 80% of verified profit to the trader and 20% to protocol revenue/reserves. Existing HyperPNL metadata records up to 90%; current payout split, cadence, minimum and eligibility remain unresolved.

blocks.title: Manual report import · 2026-08-22
paragraphs: Added decentralized/on-chain model, Dynamic Shadowing, three profitable-day scenarios, dynamic daily drawdown, payout verification steps, evaluation metrics, fee matrix, smart-contract components and the PSF concept.
SQL entity and routine recommendations from the report were intentionally excluded as product facts. The PSF formula was also omitted because the report does not provide a populated formula.
Several implementation-level details are marked pending or conflict because the local report contains no URL evidence and existing HyperPNL source metadata does not independently verify them.
